recommendation: Keep the source fix. It is a bounded reconciliation of the published FHIR-29312 clarification with later DeviceDefinition canonical-resource changes; related terminology and Basic UDI-DI modeling work should remain governed by their own issues.
issue_request: FHIR-29312 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification OO resolution for R5. It requested clarification of Device and DeviceDefinition identifier/type relationships, including DeviceDefinition.identifier versus udiDeviceIdentifier, partNumber, and modelNumber, and Device.identifier versus serialNumber and lotNumber.
initial_application: Commit 004ec6791ef344fdb1e31df772b032f8ea00586e initially applied the issue by adding clarification text to source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml and source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml. Later FHIR-42900 DeviceDefinition canonical-resource work replaced the active DeviceDefinition.identifier definition and left the FHIR-29312 wording only in a commented-out legacy element; FHIR-51403 later code-formatted the active Device.identifier comment but preserved its DeviceDefinition.identifier target.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists device and devicedefinition, so both edited StructureDefinition files are current build inputs. FHIR-42900 explains why the newer DeviceDefinition.identifier definition should stay canonical-resource oriented, making an ElementDefinition comment the safest place to restore the FHIR-29312 relationship guidance. Later UDI identifier discussions and FHIR-31750/FHIR-34356 show that typed identifiers in DeviceDefinition.identifier or Device.identifier remained part of the model for complementary UDI identifiers, while Basic UDI-DI was split to DeviceDefinition.regulatoryIdentifier.
reconciliation: Added an active DeviceDefinition.identifier comment explaining when identifier is used relative to udiDeviceIdentifier, partNumber, and modelNumber, and corrected the Device.identifier comment so serialNumber and lotNumber identifiers are permitted in Device.identifier rather than DeviceDefinition.identifier.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: added an active comment to DeviceDefinition.identifier restoring the udiDeviceIdentifier/partNumber/modelNumber relationship guidance without replacing the canonical-resource definition.
source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml: corrected the Device.identifier comment so serialNumber/lotNumber identifiers are allowed in Device.identifier, not DeviceDefinition.identifier.

related_jiras.note: Made DeviceDefinition a CanonicalResource and replaced the active DeviceDefinition.identifier definition, which explains why FHIR-29312 needed restoration as a comment rather than by reverting the newer definition.
Formatted Device element references in the same comment but preserved the incorrect DeviceDefinition.identifier target for Device serial/lot identifiers.

Later identifier-type work discusses representing complementary UDI identifiers in DeviceDefinition.identifier and Device.identifier, supporting typed identifier usage but requiring separate terminology/UTG work.
Added DeviceDefinition.regulatoryIdentifier for Basic UDI-DI, showing that Basic UDI-DI is handled separately from the identifier guidance restored here.
Later no-change issue declined multiple part/model number elements and does not alter the FHIR-29312 identifier clarification.
